dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp-edged white spotting and barring on the distal edges of dark flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct linear transition from a black posterior crown to a uniform medium-gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Vivid red patch on the anterior crown and a high-contrast white patch on the lower back/rump area.
